title: cylie: certificates, configurations, and a standalone exact-arithmetic verifier for cylinder insertions and expansions

creators.name: Matić, Ivan
creators.affiliation: Baruch College, City University of New York

creators.name: Radoičić, Radoš
creators.affiliation: Baruch College, City University of New York

description:
Data and standalone verifier for the computer-assisted proofs in the paper Insertion and expansion of cylinders around the unit ball by I. Matić, R. Radoičić and A. Spomer.

The repository contains rational certificates showing that no more than n non-overlapping cylinders of the stated radii can touch the unit ball for n = 4, 5, 6, 7, explicit rational configurations for the insertion results, and the verifier cylie, which checks all of them in exact arithmetic.
